verdict.rationale: Smithery remains a public MCP registry after the hosted-service shutdown. Its maintained CLI documents searching "thousands of skills and MCP servers" (smithery mcp search) and finding tools by query (smithery tool find), and each published server gets a discovery page. Capability-oriented browsing is only implied by keyword search plus descriptive listings, so coverage is partial. missing for 10: documented capability/category filtering or faceted browse, first-party docs for the web browse UI post-shutdown, independent hands-on corroboration of search quality and catalog scale.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search and browse a large catalog of MCP servers and tools by capability before wiring anything into my agent

citations.quote: Smithery CLI connects your agents to thousands of skills and MCP servers directly from the command line.
Get a dedicated server page where users can discover, try, and install your MCP from any client
Smithery will remain as a public (non-proxied) MCP registry.
